description: Search NYC payroll records by agency, job title, pay frequency, pay date, or amount range. Requires fiscal_year or calendar_year. NOTE: the Checkbook NYC API does not expose employee names — payroll data is aggregated by agency/title/pay date. There is no employee-name search.

agency_code.description: 3-digit agency code, e.g. '056' for NYPD, '040' for Education

calendar_year.description: Calendar year, e.g. '2025'. Either fiscal_year or calendar_year is required.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year, e.g. '2026'. Either fiscal_year or calendar_year is required.

name: search_payroll
